description: This file defines an abstract base class 'BaseEntity' for use as a superclass in Java persistence models. It provides common entity properties such as 'id', 'createdAt', and 'updatedAt', with automatic timestamp management.

classes.name: BaseEntity
classes.description: Abstract superclass for entities, providing ID and auditing timestamps with automatic update on modifications.

methods.name: preUpdate
methods.description: Method annotated with @PreUpdate to automatically update the 'updatedAt' timestamp before entity persistence updates.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the entity.

methods.name: getCreatedAt
methods.description: Returns the creation timestamp of the entity.

methods.name: getUpdatedAt
methods.description: Returns the last updated timestamp of the entity.
